intent: Repair the homepage camera service deck so category selection keeps the service packages in the same mobile reading path.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The owner reported that changing category makes the services fall below the mobile reading path.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: La acción principal debe ser obvia, cómoda para el pulgar y decir lo que pasa al tocar. Si cuesta descubrir dónde empezar, la mecánica no está terminada.
visual_evidence.comparison: Current separate camera/lens, category choices, and service banner versus one deck with a compact camera header, a 2 by 2 category grid, and packages directly beneath.

references.borrow: Keep the category and price legible.
references.avoid: Do not split the selection from the service packages.

brief.visitor: A property professional, business owner, or creator choosing the kind of video help they need.
brief.promise: Choose the kind of work and see the relevant starting price and packages without losing the selected service.
brief.primary_action: Open a package scope or begin the existing scoped-quote flow.
brief.friction: The chosen category and the service packages are separated vertically on a phone.

kpi.outcome: Qualified quote intent after an understandable service selection.
kpi.baseline: No comparable completion cohort has been read; this repair protects the existing visible-price path.
kpi.evidence: The owner screenshot and current component structure show the selected packages below a separate visual banner.
kpi.readout: Compare chooser selection and quote intent after production traffic accrues.
kpi.decision_rule: Keep only if selection is understandable without an extra scroll to regain the service context.

concept.brand_reason: A camera is an appropriate physical metaphor for choosing filming, property content, or editing without making unverified gear claims.
concept.interaction: Tap one of four named category choices.
concept.visible_response: The selected label, canonical price, and package list update in the same component.
concept.direct_path: The default state shows a selected category, price, and first package immediately.
concept.alternatives: A separate equipment page waits for factual model and ownership confirmation.

story.opening: A compact tactile camera face names the selected need.
story.consequence: The chosen service packages appear immediately below the choice grid.
story.next_step: The visitor opens scope or begins the existing quote flow.

content.visible: Selected need, canonical starting price, four choices, and package heading/first package.
content.optional_html: Existing native details keep scope and terms in server-rendered HTML.

references.borrow: The current tactile camera visual and visible-price hierarchy.
references.avoid: Duplicate controls, faux technical telemetry, unverified gear facts, and a second banner between selection and packages.

components.reuse: Existing HomeProjectPath, canonical lane pricing helpers, native details, and quote funnel.
components.local_reason: The camera shell is Esteban-specific art direction around established chooser behavior.

verification.rendered_states: 375x667, 390x844, desktop; initial and each selected category.
verification.motion: Selection, keyboard, touch, and reduced-motion states.
verification.accessibility_performance: Semantic buttons, selected state, 44px targets, and no horizontal overflow.
verification.raw_html: All category prices and package content remain in initial HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: Existing package/quote action opens the existing authorized flow.
